name: rhizomind
description: Local-only knowledge base with linked Markdown notes. No sync, no cloud, no telemetry.
author: Rhizomind contributors

scripts.check:network: npm run build:ui && vite build --sourcemap hidden --outDir ../.network-check/dist --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node tools/check-no-network/cli.ts src src-isolation dist --maps dist=.network-check/dist
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt -p rhizomind -p gen-vault --check && cargo clippy -p rhizomind -p gen-vault --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p rhizomind -p gen-vault --locked
scripts.check:deny: cargo deny --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked check && cargo deny --manifest-path tools/gen-vault/Cargo.toml --locked --config src-tauri/deny.toml check -A license-not-encountered -A advisory-not-detected
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:network && npm run check:licenses && npm run check:rust && npm run check:deny && npm run check:cargo-tree
